subject: Compliance packaging and pricing for HarborHealth — audit logs / KMS / residency
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Anna Summers <anna.summers@harborhealth.org>, Brian Cho <brian.cho@harborhealth.org>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Compliance packaging and baseline pricing questions

Hi Anna / Brian —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our call I wanted to outline a few ways we commonly package the compliance/security add-ons so you have something concrete to review with procurement and legal. I attached a short SOW draft to show how the items map to a contract.

High level options:
- A la carte: per-feature monthly line items (audit logs retention, KMS seats / HSM access, per-region residency premium). Good if you want tight control.
- Compliance bundle: includes audit logs (7 year retention), KMS seats (discounted rate), and a residency block for one extra region — applies at a committed spend tier.
- Enterprise (full): bundle + SOC2 evidence package + annual on-site add-on (if requested).

A couple of clarifying questions to help us price accurately:
1) Do you require dedicated HSM (FIPS-certified) or will a customer-managed cloud KMS satisfy legal?
2) Which data flows need regional residency (EU vs US only)?
3) Is a 12-month committed term acceptable for a bundle discount, or do you prefer annual commitments?

If you can reply with answers to the above we’ll send a quick pricing worksheet with concrete numbers and a suggested mutual action plan.

Attachments: HarborHealth_SOW_draft.pdf

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124
From: Anna Summers <anna.summers@harborhealth.org>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Brian Cho <brian.cho@harborhealth.org>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Compliance packaging and baseline pricing questions

Connor — thanks for the summary. Quick answers below to steer pricing:

1) We need HSM-backed keys for production PHI per our security policy (FIPS 140-2/3). A cloud KMS is OK for non-PHI dev/test.
2) Residency: primary data must remain in the US; however a subset of patient metadata for European clinics must be stored in an EU region (we'll provide a scoped list).
3) Procurement prefers 12-month contract but we can discuss multi-year commitments if there are meaningful discounts.

Requirements you should price for:
- HSM seats (minimum 2 production seats; ability to scale)
- Audit log retention: 7 years, immutable export capability, S3-compatible export to our archive
- Per-region residency add-on for EU region (one region to start)

Also please include any standard SOC2 evidence deliverables you provide to customers (workbook, control mappings). We will have security request follow-ups and a questionnaire; could you also attach the evidence checklist?

Thanks —
Anna Summers
Director, IT Security — HarborHealth
anna.summers@harborhealth.org | +1 202-555-0199
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Anna Summers <anna.summers@harborhealth.org>, Brian Cho <brian.cho@harborhealth.org>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 13:08:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Compliance packaging and baseline pricing questions

Anna — appreciate the clarity. Attached is a short pricing worksheet with three commercial options and the SOC2 evidence checklist you requested. Numbers below are list pricing; we can apply discounts once we confirm committed spend.

Option A — A la carte (monthly):
- Audit logs (7yr immutable retention, export API): $2,750 / month
- HSM seat (production): $1,250 / seat / month (min 2 seats)
- EU residency block (adds EU region capability + data routing): $3,200 / month

Option B — Compliance bundle (12-month commit):
- Includes audit logs + 2 HSM seats + EU residency block
- Bundle price: $6,500 / month (represents ~15% saving vs a la carte)
- First-year promotional discount: 20% off total for signed 12-month term if committed before July 20

Option C — Enterprise (multi-year):
- Bundle + SOC2 evidence package + quarterly evidence refreshes + premium support
- Starting at $58k / year; volume discounts available for larger footprints

Additional notes:
- We can structure HSM as customer-managed HSM if HarborHealth wants to provide keys, but base price assumes Redwood-managed HSM seats.
- SOC2 evidence checklist attached as "SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx".
- I attached a draft pricing workbook: HarborHealth_Compliance_Pricing_Proposal.xlsx.

Next steps I suggest: confirm whether HarborHealth wants Redwood-managed HSM or customer-managed keys, and which bundle (if any) you prefer. Once you confirm, Connor can send an AMP and we’ll open a DocuSign envelope for signature.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0187
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0000
Subject: internal: pricing floor check

Quick internal — Priyom, the numbers look reasonable but margins on HSM seats are tight. If HarborHealth asks for concessions we can offer:
- KMS/HSM first-year promotional rate: $900 / seat / month (limit 2 seats) if they sign the 12-month bundle by July 20.
- Preserve audit logs pricing but include the immutable export connector at no charge for the first year for the Compliance bundle.

Connor — can you float those concessions in the next customer-facing note? I want to keep them tied to the 12-month AMP so we protect renewal economics.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Enterprise Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Anna Summers <anna.summers@harborhealth.org>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Brian Cho <brian.cho@harborhealth.org>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2026 16:44:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Compliance packaging and baseline pricing questions

Team — thanks, this is helpful. HarborHealth preference is to go with the Compliance bundle (Option B) provided we can:
1) Lock the first-year promotional discount (20% for a 12-month term)
2) Take the HSM concession (first-year seats at $900 / month, min 2) conditional on inclusion in AMP and visible in the SOW
3) Receive the SOC2 evidence workbook and the immutable export connector included for year one

If you can send a cleaned AMP + a final pricing worksheet reflecting the concessions we’ll route to contracts and legal. Also please send a DocuSign link for the AMP so procurement can get signatures quickly — we aim to complete procurement review by 07/16.

DocuSign requested: https://www.docusign.com/harborhealth/hb-compliance-2026
HubSpot: deal HB-2026-072

Best,
Anna Summers
Director, IT Security — HarborHealth
anna.summers@harborhealth.org
summary: Negotiation thread for HarborHealth compliance add-ons. Customer needs HSM-backed keys for PHI, 7-year immutable audit logs, and an EU residency block. Redwood proposed a la carte and bundle options; internal team authorized promotional concessions (HSM $900/seat for year one, export connector included) contingent on a 12-month AMP. Customer requests final AMP, pricing worksheet, and DocuSign link to proceed to procurement by 2026-07-16.
